Description_ZH: 持续被动恢复生命值，生命值较低时速率提升
Description_EN: Continuously passively regenerates Health, rate increases when Health is low

Description_ZH: 起搏器皮肤
在修复套件启动和结束时生成生命值增强器
Description_EN: Spawns Health Boosters when Repkit starts and ends

Description_ZH: 生命值提升器皮肤
除颤仪皮肤
当生命值低于20%时，有50%几率补充1个修复套件能量点
Description_EN: When Health is below 20%, has a 50% chance to refill 1 Repkit Charge

Description_ZH: 造成暴击伤害时治疗145生命值
Description_EN: Heals for 145 on Critical Damage Dealt

Description_ZH: 鲜血皮肤
血液分析仪皮肤
使用时对最后受到的元素伤害类型免疫，持续7秒
Description_EN: On use, grants immunity to the last received Elemental Damage type for 7 seconds

Description_ZH: 盖革类固醇皮肤
该修复套件拥有3个能量点，且有30%几率在击杀敌人时补充1个能量点
Description_EN: This Repkit has 3 Charges, and a 30% chance to refill 1 Charge on enemy kill

Description_ZH: 三重旁通皮肤
治疗在最后4秒内受到的最后5次伤害
Description_EN: Heals for the last 5 instances of Damage taken within the last 4 seconds

Description_ZH: 血月皮肤
修复套件持续时间增加+100%，而冷却时间减少-50%
Description_EN: Repkit Duration increased by +100%, and Cooldown reduced by -50%

Description_ZH: 义体AF1000皮肤
当激活修复套件时，对附近敌人每秒造成2320电击伤害，并有100%几率反射子弹。
Description_EN: While Repair Kit is active, deal 2320 Shock Damage per second to nearby enemies and gain a 100% chance to reflect bullets.

Description_ZH: 击杀时将多余伤害的100%转移至会寻找附近友方的治疗魔球
Description_EN: On kill, converts 100% of overkill damage into a healing orb that seeks nearby allies

Description_ZH: 杀戮之春皮肤
闪亮战妆皮肤
使用时获得+30%射速和+30%移动速度并持续15秒，每次受到伤害时修复套件冷却时间减少2秒
Description_EN: On use, gain +30% Fire Rate and +30% Movement Speed for 15s. Taking damage reduces Repkit Cooldown by 2s

Description_ZH: 肾上腺素泵皮肤
卷土重来时自动恢复生命值
Description_EN: Automatically regenerates Health during Fight For Your Life

Description_ZH: 装填一定比例的弹药，数量与使用时治疗的生命值百分比相等
Description_EN: Reloads a percentage of ammo equal to the percentage of health healed on use

Description_ZH: 氧化皮肤
